ba skyed 0)cing yang dag par dga' bar byed pa'i tshe/ rma ②'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i yang dag par bskul bas yang dag par bskul ba yin te/ de ltar na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo des chags pa'i mtha' thams cad yongs su spangs ①pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la legs so zhes bya ba gnang ste/ rab 'byor de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la chags pa'i rnam pa de lta bu dag ston pa legs so legs so/ /rab 'byor de bas na khyod la chags pa'i rnam pa de (gebs kyang phra ba bstan par byas⑤/ de shin du legs par nyon la yid la zung (6)shig dang bstan par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar bgyi'o zhes nas/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor bcom ldan 'das la phyir nyan to(pe/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor 'di la rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan mar yid la byed na/ rab 'byor ji tsam du mtshan mar gyur pa de tsam du chags pa'o/ /gang yang 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chags pa thams cad dang bral ba de dag gi thugs nidang po bskyed pa nas/ dam pa'i chos gnas pa'i bar gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad mtshan mar yid la byed cing / yid la byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo na/ rab 'byor ji tsam du mtshan mar yid la byed pa de tsam du chags pa'o/ /gang yang de 27—454

bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos de dag dang / de ma yin pa'i sems can gzhan rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ji snyed pa de thams cad kyang mtshan mar byas te/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo na/ rab 'byor ji tsam du mtshan mar yid la byed pa de tsam du chags pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni mtshan mar yid la bya ba ma yin te/de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang mtshan mar yid la bya ba ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ni zab po//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dben pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa bcom ldan ①'das shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa (kyem byas mngon par 'du ma byas pa ste/ de ni sus kyang mngon par 'tshang rgya bar bya bar ②mi nus so/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni mngon par sangs ma rgyas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar chos kyi rang bzhin ni gnyis ma yin te/ chos kyi rang bzhin ni gcig tu zad do/ /rab 'byor chos kyi rang bzhin ni gcig po gang yin pa de ni rang bzhin ma yin no/ /gang rang bzhin ma yin pa de ni ma byas pa'o/ /gang ma byas pa de ni mngon par 'dus dum byas pa'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ chos kyi rang bzhin gcig po gang rang bzhin ma yin pa ma byas pa mngon par 'dus ma byas pa shes na chags pa'i rnam pa thams cad yongs su spangs pa yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin 27—455

pa ni rtogs par dka' ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ni sus kyang ma mthong ma rtogs/ rnam par mi shes mngon par sangs ma rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar sems kyis ma shes so/ /gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pas ma shes so/ /skye mched dang khams dang rten cing 'brel par 'byung bas ma shes so/ /pha rol du phyin pa rnams dang stong pa nyid rnams dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis ma shes so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang mngon par shes pa rnams kyis ma shes so/ /ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi ༅sgo rnams kyis ma shes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig ②pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad kyis ma shes so/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub kyis ma shes so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis ma shes so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa las/ chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste/27—456

nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ni bgyid pa ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byed pa po mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro / /rab 'byor de bzhin du gzugs mi dmigs pa dang /tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa mi dmigs pa dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du mi dmigs ①pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pas rnam pa ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te gzugs la mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la mi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye mched dang khams dang /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te pha rol du phyin pa thams cad dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 27—457

'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams la mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams la mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad la mi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te thams cad shes pa nyid dang /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya bar mi spyod na/27—458

shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa bdag ces bya ba'amacha/ bdag med ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te gzugs sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang rtag pa'am mi rtag pa'am / bde ba'am sdug bsngal ba'am/ bdag gam bdag med pa'am/sdug pa'am mi sdug par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i gzugs med do/ /gang rtag pa'am/mi rtag pa'am bde ba'am/ sdug bsngal ba'am/ bdag gam/ bdag med pa'am / sdug pa'am/ mi sdug par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i tshor ba dang 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa med do/ /gang rtag pa'am mi rtag pa'am/ bde ba'am sdug bsngal ba'am/ bdag gam bdag med pa'am/sdug pa'am mi sdug par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du med do// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ bam po bzhi bcu pa/rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi 27—459

pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gal te gzugs yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye mched dang khams dang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /pha rol du phyin pa thams cad dang / stong pa nyid thams cad yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang /mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te ting nge 'dzin rnams dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /27—460

mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du yongs su ma rdzogs so zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzugs yongs su ma rdzogs pa gang yin pa de gzugs ma yin no zhes bya bar ①de ltar yang mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /tshor ba dang 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa gang yin pa de rnam par shes pa ma yin no zhes bya ba ②de ltar yang mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du yongs su ma rdzogs pa gang yin pa de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin no zhes bya bar ①de ltar yang mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo rnams la chags pa dang ma chags pa legs par bstan pa 'di ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo rnams la chags pa dang / ma chags pa legs par bstan to/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod 27—461

pa'i tshe/ gal te gzugs chags pa'am ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /gal te skye mched dang khams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la ①chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /nang stong pa nyid chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang /bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams chags pa'am 27—462

ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang gzungs ①kyi sgo rnams chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad chags pa'am ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar mi spyod na/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod do/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod na/ gzugs chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med do/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med do/ /skye mched dang khams dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med do/ /pha rol du phyin pa thams cad dang ②/ stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya 27—463

bar 'du shes pa med do①/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig ②pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med do/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid chags pa'am/ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med doni/ /rang byang chub chags pa'am/ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med do/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chags pa'am/ ma chags pa zhes bya bar 'du shes pa med do/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ltar chos zab mo 'di bstan kyang yongs su mi 'grib/ ma bstan kyang yongs su mi 'grib/ bstan kyang mi 'phel/ma bstan kyang mi 'phel ba ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de de bzhin no/ /rab 'byor de de bzhin te/ chos zab mo 'di bstan kyang yongs su mi 'grib/ ma bstan kyang yongs su mi 'grib/ bstan kyang mi 'phel ma bstan kyang mi 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs shing / nam mkha'i legs pa'am/ ma legs pa brjod kyang /nam mkha' ni legs pa brjod pas yongs su 'phel ba med do/ /nyes pa brjod pas yongs su 'grib pa med do/ /nam mkha' ni legs pa brjod kyang chags 27—464

par 'gyur ba 'phel ba ①med do/ /nyes pa brjod kyang khong khro bar 'gyur ②ba med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu ni legs pa brjod kyang 'phel ba med do/ /nyes pa brjod kyang yongs su 'grib pa med do/ /legs pa brjod kyang chags par 'gyur ba med do/ /nyes pa brjod kyang khong khro bar 'gyur ba med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du chos rnams kyi chos nyid gang yin pa de bstan kyang de bzhin/ ma bstan kyang de bzhin no/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du byin pa la spyod cing / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa bstan pa'i tshe zhum pa dang / g.yeng bar mi 'gyur ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di la ③brtson par bgyid cing bla na med pa duyang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa ni ⑤dka' ba bgyid pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ⑥bsgom pa 'di ni nam mkha' ⑦bsgom pa ste/ nam mkha' la ni gzugs ma mchis so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa ma mchis so/ /nam mkha' la ni skye mched dang / khams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ma mchis so /nam mkha' la ni sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa ma mchis soni/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ma mchis so/ /nam mkha' la ni nang stong pa nyid ma mchis so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du ma mchis so /27—465

nam mkha' la ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma mchis so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang /stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma mchis so/ /nam mkha' la ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams ma mchis so/ /nam mkha' la ni ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma mchis so/ /nam mkha' la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad ma mchis so/ /nam mkha' la ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ma mchis so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub ma mchis so/ /nam mkha' la ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gis go cha 'di 'tshal ba de dag ni phyag bgyi bar 'os pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gis go cha 'di 'tshal ba de dag ni nam mkha'i don du brtson par ①mos 'bad par mos/ rtsol bar mos pa dag ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang gis sems can rnams kyi slad du go cha 'tshal ba de dag ni nam mkha' yongs su smin par 27—466

'tshal zhing yongs su grol bar 'tshal ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams kyi slad du go cha 'tshal ba de dag ni go cha chen po 'tshal ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams kyi don du go cha 'tshal ba de dag ni nam mkha' bar snang la gdeg par 'tshal ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang sems can rnams kyi slad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa de dag ni brtson 'grus chen po thob pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang sems can rnams kyi don du/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs pa de dag ni go cha chen po 'tshal ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams kyi slad du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'tshal ba de dag ni/dpa' bo bsam gyis mi khyab mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i go cha 'tshal ba'o de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di/ 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dam bu'i byings ①sam/'od ma'i tshal lam/ bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ rtsig ma'i tshal lam/'bras kyi zhing ngam/ til gyi zhing bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa mang pos ②yongs su gang bar gyur la/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis kyang bskal pa'am/bskal pa'i lhag mar chos bstan te de bzhin gshegs pa re res sems can tshad ma mchis/ grangs ma mchis pa yongs su mya ngan las bzlas ①kyang / bcom ldan 'das sems can gyi khams la 'grib pa'am/ gang dubar mi gda'o/ /de 27—467

ci'i slad du zhe na/ sems can ma mchis pa dang / sems can dben pa'i slad du ste/ de bzhin du gal te phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re zhing yang / 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dam bu'i byings ①sam/ 'od ma'i tshal lam/ bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ snyig ma'i tshal lam/ 'bras kyi zhing ngam til gyi zhing bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa mang pos yongs su gang bar gyur la de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis kyang bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i ②lhag mar chos bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa re res sems can tshad ma mchis/ grangs ma mchis pa yongs su mya ngan las bzlas ①kyang / sems can gyi khams la 'grib pa'am gang bar dumi gda'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ sems can ma mchis pa dang / sems can dben pa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam grangs des na bdag 'di skad du sems can rnams kyi slad du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar ⑤'tshal ba de dag ni nam mkha' yongs su smin par bgyi bar 'tshal zhing yongs su dgrol bar 'tshal ba lags zhes mchi'o/ /de nas dge slong gcig cig 'di snyam du gyur te/ gang la chos gang yang skye ba dang 'gag pa yang med la/ tshul khrims kyi phung po yang yod/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po yang yod/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang yod/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub kyang yod/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang yod/ rgyun du zhugs pa 27—468

yang yod/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyang yod/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang yod/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang /chos dkon mchog dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang yod/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yang yod pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo snyam pa dang / de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa zab mo 'di la brtson par byed pa zhig yod na/ de ①gang la brtson par byed pa yin/rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka gang shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di la bslab par sems pa de ni nam mkha' stong pa la brtson pa'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de la bdag gis bsrung ba dang /bskyang ba dang / bskyab pa ji lta bu zhig bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kau ②shi ka khyod kyis gang la bsrung ba dang / bskyang ba dang / bskyab par bya ba'i chos de lta bu yang dag par rjes su mthong ngam/ smras pa btsun pa rab 'byor bdag gis gang la bsrung ba dang / bskyang ba dang / bskyab par bya ba'i chos de lta bu yang dag 27—469

par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo ji skad du bstan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la gnas na/ de nyid de'i bsrung ba dang / bskyang ba dang / bskyab par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ji skad du bstan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang bral bar gyur na/ de la mi'am mi ①ma yin pa glags tshol ba rnams kyis ②glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gang ji skad du bstan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la mi gnas pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang bral bar rig par bya'o/ /kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa rnams bsrung ba dang /bskyang ba dang / bskyab par gang sems pa de ni nam mkha' la bsrung ba dang bskyang ③ba dang / bskyab par sems pa ste/ de ni bsam pa ltar mi 'grub cing dub pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ khyod kyis rjosgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / mi ⑤lam dang / sgra brnyan dang / myig duyor dang / ⑩sprul pa la bsrung ba dang / bskyang ba dang / bskyab par nus sam/brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ni mi nus so/ /smras pa/kau shi ka de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa rnams/ bsrung ba dang bskyang ba dang / bskyab par gang sems pa de ni bsam pa ltar mi 'grub cing dub pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa la bsrung ba dang / bskyang ba dang / bskyab par nus sam / brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ni mi nus so/ /27—470

smras pa kau shi ka de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa rnams bsrung ba dang / bskyang ba dang /bskyab par gang sems pa de ni bsam pa ltar mi 'grub cing dub pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka de ji gyesnyam du sems/ khyod kyis chos kyi dbyings dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / de bzhin nyid dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings la bsrung ba dang / bskyang ba dang bskyab par nus sam/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ni mi nus so/ /smras pa/ kau shi ka de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa rnams bsrung ba dang / bskyang ②ba dang bskyab par gang sems pa de ni bsam pa ltar mi 'grub cing dub pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa rab 'byor ji tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pas/ rmi lam lta bu'i chos dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu dang / sgra brnyan lta bu dang / mig yor lta bu dang / 8sprul pa lta bu'i chos rnams yongs su shes pa dang / de ltar yongs su shes pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi lam rlom sems su mi byed④/ rmi lam gyis rlom sems su mi byed/dumi lam la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /sprul pa'i bar du rlom sems su mi byed/sprul pas rlom sems su mi byed/ ⑩sprul pa la rlom sems su mi byed pa yin/rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs rlom sems su 27—471

mi byed/ gzugs kyis rlom sems su mi byed/ ①gzugs la rlom sems su mi byed na/ de rmi lam rlom sems su mi byed/ rmi lam gyis rlom sems su mi byed/②mi lam la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /sprul pa'i bar du rlom sems su mi byed/sprul pas rlom sems su mi byed/ dusprul pa la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /tshor ba dang/ 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rlom sems su mi byed/ rnam par shes pas rlom sems su mi byed/ durnam par shes pa la rlom sems su mi byed do⑤/ /de rmi lam rlom sems su 0mi byed/ ⑦mi lam gyis rlom sems su mi byed/ ⑧mi lam la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /sprul pa'i bar du rlom sems su mi byed/ sprul pas rlom sems su mi byed/ 8sprul pa la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /skye mched dang khams dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rlom sems su mi byed/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bas rlom sems su mi byed/ 0rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la rlom sems su mi byed na/de rmi lam rlom sems su mi byed/ rmi lam gyis rlom sems su mi byed/ ⑩mi lam la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /sprul pa'i bar du rlom sems su mi byed/sprul pas rlom sems su mi byed/ ⑩sprul pa la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /pha rol du phyin pa thams cad dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rlom sems su mi byed/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyis rlom sems su mi byed/ 8byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la rlom sems su mi byed na/ de rmi lam rlom sems su mi byed/rmi lam gyis rlom sems su mi byed/ tsormi lam la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /sprul pa'i bar du rlom sems su mi byed/ sprul pas rlom sems su mi byed/27—472

0sprul pa la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang /bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams rlom sems su mi byed/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyis rlom sems su mi byed/②mngon par shes pa rnams la rlom sems su mi byed na/ de mi lam rlom sems su mi byed/ mi lam gyis rlom sems su mi byed/ ③mi lam la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /sprul pa'i bar du rlom sems su mi byed/ sprul pas rlom sems su mi byed/ dusprul pa la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams rlom sems su mi byed/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis rlom sems su mi byed/ dugazungs kyi sgo rnams la rlom sems su mi byed na/ de mi lam rlom sems su mi byed/ mi lam gyis rlom sems su mi byed/ 0mi lam la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /sprul pa'i bar du rlom sems su mi byed/ sprul pas rlom sems su mi byed/ 0sprul pa la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad rlom sems su mi byed/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis rlom sems su mi byed/ dusangs rgyas kyi 0chos ma 'dres pa rnams la rlom sems su mi byed na/ de mi lam rlom sems su mi byed/rmi lam gyis rlom sems su mi byed/ 0mi lam la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /27—473

sprul pa'i bar du rlom sems su mi byed/ sprul pas rlom sems su mi byed/8sprul pa la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du rlom sems su mi byed/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis rlom sems ②su mi byed/ ①rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rlom sems su mi byed naX/de rmi lam rlom sems su mi byed/ rmi lam gyis rlom sems su mi byed/ ⑤mi lam la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /sprul pa'i bar du rlom sems su mi byed/sprul pas rlom sems su mi byed/ dusprul pa la rlom sems su mi byed do/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris ⑦kyi lha dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha dang /mtshe ma dang dga' ldan dang 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang /tshangs ris dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor dang /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi bar gyi lha'i bu gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad lha rdzas kyi tsan dan gyi phye mas/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor zhing / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal ⑤te/ phyogs gcig du 'khod do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi bar gyi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas stong yi ge 'di dag nyid kyis 0chos ston pa/ mtshan 'di nyid mnga' ba/ dge slong rab 'byor ces bya ba sha stag gis shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa zab mo 'di nyid dang /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i le'u 'di nyid zhu ba dang / de nas tunyelha'i 27—474

dbang po brgya ①byin gyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i le'u 'di nyid zhu zhing yongs su 'dri ba sems kyis mthong bar gyur to②/ /lho dang nub dang /byang dang byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang /'og dang steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs re re zhing yang / sangs rgyas stong yi ge 'di dag nyid kyis chos ston pa mtshan 'di nyid mnga' ba/ dge slong rab 'byor ces bya ba sha stag gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa zab mo 'di nyid dang /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i le'u 'di nyid zhu ba dang / de nas ③lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i le'u 'di nyid zhu zhing yongs su 'dri ba sems kyis mthong bar gyur to④/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa yang sa'i phyogs 'di nyid du/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di nyid ston cing 'chad par 'gyur ro//gang yang bskal pa bzang po 'di la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba de dag kyang / sa'i phyogs 'di nyid du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs dupa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di nyid ston cing 'chad par 'gyur ro//gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa gang dang / rtags gang dang /mtshan ma gang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di nyid ston cing 'chad par 'gyur/ de skad 27—475

ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'di la rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ gzugs rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzugs bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'am/ gzugs bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya ba'am/gzugs sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzugs zhi zhes bya ba'am/ ma zhi zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzugs bcings shes bya ba'am/ grol zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzugs 'das shes bya ba'am/ ma 'ongs shes bya ba'am/ da ltar byung ba ①zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rtag ②ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam par shes pa bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'am/ rnam par shes pa bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya ba'am/ rnam par shes pa sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam par shes pa zhi zhes bya ba'am/ ma ②zhi zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam par shes pa bcings shes bya ba'am/grol zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam par shes pa 'das shes bya ba'am / ma 'ongs shes bya ba'am/ da ltar byung zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /skye mched dang khams dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rten 27—476

cing 'brel par 'byung ba bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'am/rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya ba'am/rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhi zhes bya ba'am ma zhi zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba bcings shes bya ba'am/ grol zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'das shes bya ba'am/ ma 'ongs shes bya ba'am/da ltar byung zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /pha rol du phyin pa thams cad dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro//byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'am/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya ba'am/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun zhi zhes bya ba'am/ ma zhi zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bcings shes bya ba'am/ grol zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun 'das shes bya ba'am/ ma 'ongs shes bya ba'am/ da ltar byung zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar 27—477

pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang /stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'am/ mngon par shes pa rnams bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya ba'am/ mngon par shes pa rnams sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba'am/ma zhi zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams bcings shes bya ba'am/ grol zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams 'das shes bya ba'am/ ma 'ongs zhes bya ba'am/da ltar byung zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'am / gzungs kyi sgo rnams bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya ba'am / gzungs kyi sgo rnams sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams zhi zhes bya ba'am/ ma zhi zhes bya bar ①chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams bcings shes bya ba'am / grol zhes bya ba ②chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'das shes bya ba'am/ ma 'ongs shes bya ba'am/ da ltar byung zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs 27—478

rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams bde zhes bya ba'am / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya ba'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sdug ces bya'amaspyi/ mi sdug ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba'am ma zhi zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams bcings shes bya ba'am/ grol zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'das shes bya ba'am/ ma 'ongs shes bya ba'am/ da ltar byung zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bde zhes bya ba'am/ sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'am/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bdag ces bya ba'am/ bdag med ces bya ba'am/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sdug ces bya ba'am/ mi sdug ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba'am/ ma zhi zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bcings shes bya ba'am/grol zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'das shes bya ba'am/ ma 'ongs shes bya ba'am/ da ltar byung ba ②zhes bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang 27—479

chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ chos ni ji ltar ston par 'gyur ston nas ji ①zhig ②ston par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzugs shin du rnam par dag go zhes shin du rnam par dag pa'i chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa shin du rnam par dag go/ /zhes shin du rnam par dag pa'i chos ston par 'gyur ro skye mched dang khams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba shin du rnam par dag go/ /zhes shin du rnam par dag pa'i chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol du phyin pa thams cad dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun shin du rnam par dag go//zhes shin du rnam par dag pa'i chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams shin du rnam par dag go/ /zhes bya bar ①shin du rnam par dag pa'i chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams shin du rnam par dag go/ /zhes shin du rnam par dag pa'i chos ston par 'gyur rol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyis duchos ma 'dres pa rnams shin du rnam par dag go/ /zhes shin du rnam par dag pa'i chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du shin du rnam par dag go//27—480

zhes shin du rnam par dag pa'i chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ni yongs su dag pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs yongs su dag pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor skye mched dang /khams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /pha rol du phyin pa thams cad dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol 27—481

pa / bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na gzugs yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'i slad du/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na skye mched dang khams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yongs su dag pa'i slad du/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na pha rol du phyin pa thams cad dang stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang /mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ ji ltar na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs la skye ba med pa 27—482

dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang /rnam par byang ba med pa ni gzugs yongs su dag pa'o/ /tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la skye ba med pa dang /'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa ni rnam par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /skye mched dang khams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /pha rol du phyin pa thams cad dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa ni/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su dag pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang /bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa rnams dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang /rnam par byang ba med pa ni mngon par shes pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs ①kyi sgo rnams la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa ni gzungs kyi sgo ②yongs su dag pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 27—483

dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad yongs su dag pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang /kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'ol/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang /kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa'i phyir nam mkha' yongs su dag pa ste/ rab 'byor nam mkha' la 'gro ba med pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na nam mkha' la 'gro ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor nam mkha' gzung du med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor ①nam mkha' la tha snyad med pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar ②nam mkha' la tha snyad ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/27—484

rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i sgra brnyan gnyis kyi sgra ltar/nam mkha' la tha snyad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor nam mkha' brjod du med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na ①nam mkha' brjod du ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor nam mkha' la ni gang yang brjod du med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du nam mkha' brjod du med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nam mkha' dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar phyinam mkha' dmigs su ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor nam mkha' la gang yang dmigs su med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du nam mkha' dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos thams cad skye ba med pa dang /'gag pa med pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med ga'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na chos thams cad skye ba ma mchis pa dang /'gag pa ma mchis pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa dang /rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos 27—485

thams cad shin du rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid na/bcom ldan 'das de la mig gi nad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rna ba'i nad dang /sna'i nad dang / lce'i nad dang / lus kyi nad dang /① yan lag ma tshang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lus ngan par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgas pas 'khogs pa'i lus su mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni ②bde ba mi spongs pas dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i slad bzhin du lha brgya stong mang po 'brang bar 'gyur te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi bar gyi lha rnams kyang slad bzhin du 'brang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang na chos smra ba'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ston pa der yang / tshes brgyad dang / bcu bzhi dang / bco lnga dag la lha'i tshogs ③chen po 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de duyang shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ston pa'i tshe/ bsod nams mang du 'phel bar 'gyur te / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams kyi phung po rab tu mang ba / tshad ma mchis pa/ grangs ma mchis pa bsam gyis ⑤mi khyab pa/mtshungs pa ma mchis pa/ gzhal du ma mchis pa/ dpag tu ma mchis pa/rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang tshes brgyad dang / bcu bzhi dang bco lnga dag la shes rab kyi pha rol du 27—486

phyin pa 'di lha'i 'khor gyi mdun du ston pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel te/ bsod nams kyi phung po mang po dang / tshad med pa grangs med pa①/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshungs pa med pa gzhal du med pa dpag tu med pa rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rin po che'o / /rab 'byor de la shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa rin po che ni 'di yin te/sems can dmyal ba las yongs su grol bar byed pa'o/ /byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / mi dang lha dbul po las yongs su grol bar byed pa'o/ /rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs 'byin pa'o/ /bram ze che zhing mtho ba'i rigs 'byin pa'o/ /khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba'i rigs 'byin pa'o / /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris ②kyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o/ /'du shes med 'du shes med myin ③skye mched kyi bar gyi lha'i skye ba'i skye mched 'byin pa'o / /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'byin pa'o/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'byin pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub 'byin pa'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'byin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di las/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rgyas par bstan te/ de la bslabs pas rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams duyod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi dulha rnams yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang /dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod 27—487

do/ /tshangs ris dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen ①dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang / chung dge dang /tshad med dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang / chung che ba ③dang /tshad med che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / mi che ba dang mi gdung ba dang /shin du mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og myin ②gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / chung ༷zad med pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min ⑤skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub yod do/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di yod na/ bsam gtan bzhi yod do/ /tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yod do/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi 0chos sum cu rtsa bdun yod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid ⑦stong pa nyid kyi bar du yod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad 27—488

dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi ①'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad yod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du yod do/ /de yang 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di las chos de ②thams cad rgya cher ③bstan te/ de la bslabs na rgyal rigs che ༷zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 0yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang /'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang /tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang /snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad med snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang chung dge dang tshad med dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang che ba dang / chung che dang tshad med che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang mi che ba dang mi gdung ba dang shin du mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / chung duzad med pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med myin ⑦skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba rnams dang /27—489

dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /de bas na de ni pha rol du phyin pa rin po che zhes bya'o/ /pha rol du phyin pa rin po che de la ni chos gang yang skye ba'am/ 'gag pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba'am / yongs su gzung ①ba'am/ dor ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar gang skye ba'am/ 'gag pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/rnam par byang ba'am/ yongs su gzung ba'am/ dor bar bya ba'i chos de lta bu med do/ /rab 'byor pha rol du phyin pa rin po che 'di la ni dge ba'am/mi dge ba'am/ 'jig rten pa'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'am/ zag pa dang bcas pa'am zag pa med pa'am/ 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas kyi chos gang yang dmigs su med de rab 'byor rnam grangs nges kyang pha rol du phyin pa rin po che ni dmigs su med do/ /rab 'byor pha rol du phyin pa rin po che ②la ni gang gis kyang 'go ②ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang 'go bar du'agyur ba'i chos de lta bu dmigs su med do⑤/ /rab 'byor de'i phyir na pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'go dub med pa'i pha rol du phyin pa rin po che'o/ /rab 'byor gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ de ltar 'du shes par yang mi byed la/de ⑦ltar mi rtog cing de ltar mi dmigs te/ de ltar 'phro ⑧bar yang mi byed na shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la sgom pa'o/ /de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mnyes par byed pa'o/ /27—490

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mngon par bsams shing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la rim gror bya ba dang / bkur ster bya ba dang /bste stang du bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ste/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su spyod par byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni chos gang yang ston pa'am/ rnam par ston pa'am/ yongs su ston pa'am/ 'dzin par byed pa'am/ 'byin par byed pa'am/ skye bar byed pa'am/ 'gag par byed pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs par byed pa'am/ rnam par byang bar ①byed pa'am/ 'grib par byed pa'am/ 'phel bar byed pa'am/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang ②da ltar byung bar byed pa med do/ /rab 'byor de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'dod pa'i khams las 'da' bar byed pa ma yin/ gnas par byed pa ma yin/ gzugs kyi khams las 'da' bar byed pa ma yin/ gnas par byed pa ma yin/ gzugs med pa'i khams las 'da' bar byed pa ma yin/ gnas par byed pa ma yin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa sgrub ②pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa sgrub ④pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ nang stong pa nyid sgrub ⑤pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du sgrub rjopa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun sgrub ⑦27—491

pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgrub ①pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ rnam par thar pa dang /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams sgrub ②pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams sgrub ①pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang /mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sgrub 0pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu sgrub ⑤pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid sgrub ①pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ rang byang chub sgrub ⑦pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sgrub ༷pa ma yin 'dor ba ma yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sgrub ⑨pa ma yin/ 'dor ba ma yin no// //⑩shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ yibam po bzhi bcu gcig pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'dus byas kyi khams 'dor ba ma yin/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams sgrub 4)pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma byung yang rung / chos rnams kyi chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang /chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon 8med pa de ni de bzhin du gnas pa yin 27—492

te de ①ni de bzhin gshegs pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par thugs su chud do/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/mngon par rdzogs par thugs su chud nas kyang gsung ngo / /ston to/ /rjod do/ /'grel to/ /rnam par 'byed do/ /gsal bar mdzad do/ /yang dag par ston to/ /de nas lha'i bu stong phrag mang po steng gi bar snang la 'khod nas lhung lhung ldegs kyi sgra phyung ste/ lha rdzas kyi me tog ut+pa la dang / pad mo dang / ku mu da dang / pun da ②ri ka dang / mān dā char ba dang / mān dā dur ba chen po 'thor zhing 'di skad kyi tshig brjod par gyur to⑤/ /kye ma shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di bstan pas/ lha'i bu stong phrag du ma skye ba med pa'i chos la bzod pa skyes par gyur te/ 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor ba mthong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan rab 'byor la bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis su bskor ba yang ma yin/gcig tu bskor ba yang ma yin no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di yang chos gang yang 'khor ba'am/ mi 'khor bar bya ba'i phyir nye bar gnas pa ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di chos gang yang 'khor bar bgyi ba'am/ mi 'khor bar bgyi ba'i slad du/nye bar mi gnas pa'i dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pas stong ngo / /bsam gtan gyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol du phyin pa 27—493

dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pas stong ngo / /nang stong pa nyid nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /yang dag par spong ba rnams dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas stong ngo / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams mngon par shes pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bus stong ngo //lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong ngo / /dgra bcom pa nyid dgra bcom pa nyid kyis stong ngo //rang byang chub rang byang chub kyis stong ngo / /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid lam gyi 27—494

rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni chen mo ste / 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa rang bzhin gyis stong pa'o/ /de ni chos thams cad kyang chos thams cad kyis stong la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la gnas shing /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya yang / chos gang yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 0)ma mchis/chos kyi 'khor lo yang bskor ②la chos gang yang 'khor ba'am mi 'khor ba'am rab tu 'khor bar bgyid pa ma mchis te/ de dag gis chos gang yang yongs su mthong ba'am yongs su ma mthong ba ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang 'khor bar bgyi ba'am mi 'khor bar bgyi ba'am rab tu 'khor bar bgyi ba'i chos de lta bu dmigs su ma mchis te/ de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad kyang shin du mngon par ma grub pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ stong pa nyid ni 'khor bar bgyid pa'am/ mi 'khor bar bgyid pa ma lags so/ /mtshan ma ma mchis pa ni 'khor bar bgyid pa'am mi 'khor bar bgyid pa ma lags so/ /smon pa ma mchis pa ni 'khor bar bgyid pa'am mi 'khor bar bgyid pa ma lags so/ /de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa bstan pa dang /rab tu bstan pa dang / bsgrags pa dang rab tu dgod pa dang gzhag pa dang /rnam par dbye ba dang / rnam par dgrol ②ba dang smos pa dang / gsal bar bgyi ba dang yang dag par bstan pa 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa bstan 27—495

pa yongs su dag pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa bstan pa de yang sus kyang ma bstan sus kyang ma bzung ngo / /gang sus kyang ma bstan sus kyang ma bzung ba de ni sus kyang mngon du ma bgyis so/ /gang sus kyang mngon du ma bgyis pa de la ni yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ma mchis te/ chos bstan pa 'di la gang su yang sbyin pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba ma mchis so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa las le'u nyi shu brgyad pa'o// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nam mkha' med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni mnyam pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir ro//gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rnam par dben pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni thub pa med pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni gnas ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ming dang lus med pa'i phyir ro/ /27—496

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni nam mkha'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni brjod du ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni ming ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'gro ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'gro ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni mi 'phrogs pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/chos thams cad gzung du med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni skad cig pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad byang zhing zad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni skye ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi 27— 497

pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni byed pa po ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byed pa po dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni shes pa po ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shes pa po dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'pho ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'chi ba dang skye ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'jig pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'jig ①pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rmi lam gyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rmi lam mthong ba dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni sgra brnyan gyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan pa dang /sgrar brjod pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni mig yor gyi pha rol du phyin pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ me long gi bzhin dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni smig rgyu'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chu 'bab pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/27—498

bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni sgyu ma'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mtshan ma dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rmongs pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ma rig pa'i mun pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyon mongs pa ①med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni dmigs su ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni spros pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ spros pa thams cad yang dag par bcom pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rlom sems ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rlom sems thams cad yang dag par bcom pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni mi g.yo ba'i pha 27—499

rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos kyi dbyings gnas pa nyid ①kyi phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i pha rol du phyin pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad ma nor ba yang dag pa nyid du mngon par 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni kun nas ldang ba ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ②bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad rnam par rtog pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni zhi ba'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad mtshan ma med cing dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'dod chags ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dod chags dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni zhe sdang ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zhe snang yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni gti mug ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sel ba'i phyir rol/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 27—500

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yongs su rtog pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni sems can ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sems can med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rab tu spangs pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad kun nas ldang ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni mtha' gnyis su mi 'gyur ba'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtha' rnam par spong ba'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab ①kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni tha mi dad pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'dres pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni nyams pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las ②'da' bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rnam par rtog pa ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni ming ①ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/chos thams cad kyi tshad dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom 27—501

ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni nam mkha'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad la chags pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni mi rtag pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad 'jig pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/chos thams cad tshol ①bar sbyor ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni bdag ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad la mngon par chags pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni mtshan nyid ma mchis pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad mngon par grub ②pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni nang stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nang gi chos dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro//gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni phyi stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/27—502

phyi'i chos dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyi nang gi chos dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni chen po stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chen po stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir rol/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro//gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i 27—503

phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyi nang gi chos dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dben pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dben pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni dngos po med pa stong pa nyid kyi pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid kyi phyir ro/ /27—504
